title: High Probability vs. Low Probability: minden bizonnyal and aligha

sections.title: Polarity of Predictions
sections.content: *Minden bizonnyal* expresses strong likelihood ('in all probability, almost certainly'). Conversely, *aligha* expresses extreme skepticism or negative probability ('hardly, scarcely, unlikely to happen').

items.spanish: Minden bizonnyal sikerrel zárul a hosszú kutatómunka.
items.english: In all probability, the lengthy research work will conclude successfully.

items.spanish: Aligha fogja bárki is kétségbe vonni az elért eredmények hitelességét.
items.english: Hardly anyone will question the credibility of the achieved results.
